title: Frame counter and main-loop rate (proof of the tool)
instructions_pt: Carregue um save e fique no mapa livre, com o PPSSPP a 100 % de velocidade (sem fast-forward).
Deixe o jogo rodando, sem pausar, por pelo menos 70 segundos.
Termine com q. Este teste não precisa de nenhuma ação no jogo.

expected.what: +0x04..+0x0b stay zero (by hand: zero in all saves)

not_possible: Saves E7-a/b/c and their diffs stay by hand (save.py); this run covers the in-memory counter only.
The 60 s stopwatch is the client's wall clock; 100 % speed is inferred from gpu.stats.get, not read.
notes: The plan's save_tick_frame_counter is system_run_frame_services in re/functions.csv; the counter store is at 0x08835a38.
